original_test_intent: Verify every expected network-adapter PCIe physical/virtual function is present at the correct BDF with approved PF/VF/SR-IOV identity and properties, while resolving the unrelated network-port health criterion.
original_method: Pin NVSM build; preserve diagnostics; approve safe port cabling; load adapter-to-PF/VF/BDF/device-ID/driver/IOMMU/SR-IOV manifest; run exact query read-only; compare complete function hierarchy and properties; record port health separately only if explicitly mapped; never enable/disable VFs or alter networking.
manual_activity: Network/platform owner supplies PF/VF manifest and resolves whether port health is a separate required checkpoint.
required_inputs: Expected SR-IOV VF counts and disabled-function policy
safety_requirements: Never create/destroy VFs, bind drivers or change IOMMU/network state
Do not connect ports without loop review
No log clearing or automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Report source conflict and evidence without DUT verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The query is applicable but lacks PF/VF/SR-IOV expectations and conflates function inventory with port health.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run the literal command and map every function to stable adapter/BDF identity; evaluate ports only under a separate approved mapping.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All network PCIe functions and connect-all-ports precondition are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build an adapter/PF/VF function tree with BDF, IDs, driver/IOMMU and expected VF counts, plus separately referenced port evidence if retained.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Separates PCIe function correctness from physical port health.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A healthy physical port does not prove PF/VF enumeration or driver binding.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: VF counts and BDFs can change with approved SR-IOV settings; compare to the declared mode.

project_override_considerations: Network/virtualization owner defines enabled VF count, driver ownership and whether port health belongs in this row.
expected_evidence: Declared SR-IOV mode and safe cabling

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Item/Procedure target PCIe network device functions, but Criteria additionally require all network ports Status_Health OK without mapping ports to function acceptance.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Read-only function inventory is possible; criterion decision and manifests are provisionable.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row340 Wistron-NV GPU-00333-V003: decide whether port Status_Health is part of PCIe PF/VF function acceptance or a separate checkpoint; approve adapter/PF/VF/BDF/driver/IOMMU/SR-IOV manifest and safe port cabling while preserving logs.

review_improvement: Prevents physical-port health from masking missing or misbound network PCIe functions and preserves SR-IOV mode context.
independent_technical_reasoning: Ports and PCIe functions are many-to-many across multifunction adapters and VFs often have no direct physical port. A port-health statement cannot establish PF/VF count, BDF identity or driver binding without an explicit mapping.
